project.purpose: Preserve durable semantic continuity, collaboration records, replay-safe mutation identity, and exact re-entry coordinates without becoming scheduler, priority authority, Agent identity authority, Runtime proxy, deployment truth, or domain truth.

kernelLaws.law: Host may remember a claim; Host must not silently promote it into foreign truth.
A Host projection may recommend exact re-entry; it must not grant foreign authority, priority, ownership, assignment, or execution admission.
Continuity identity and revision semantics must survive implementation replacement; storage, search, cursor encoding, transport, and language are replaceable.

nodes.label: CurrentnessProjection

workStanding.rule: No production/runtime consumer code was found, but workStanding is present in 233/266 current non-terminal checkpoints. Treat Host interpretation/control semantics as subtraction candidates; do not delete the persisted envelope without a migration/compatibility proof.

feedbackLoops.name: continuity_feedback_gain
feedbackLoops.warning: Task/message counts are activity metrics, not value metrics.

experiments.name: fresh-agent-reentry
experiments.question: Can a fresh Agent recover the correct frontier from bounded Host coordinates without hidden conversation state?
experiments.finding: E01a real Host mechanical replay matched task identity/revision/state/checkpoint digest for 8/8 sampled non-terminal Tasks. E01b frozen synthetic fresh-consumer A/B completed 24/24 provider calls: R6 full A and R7 compact B both achieved 12/12 exact task.resume selections; B reduced mean provider request bytes 54.45%, mean prompt tokens 46.10%, and request-token upper bound 54.00%.
experiments.nextGate: E01 outcome gate is satisfied for compact-read integration; preserve task.resume exact hydration and existing authority boundaries.

experiments.name: r6-vs-r7-compact-read
experiments.question: Does compact task inventory materially reduce discovery cost while preserving exact task.resume semantics?
experiments.finding: Compact-read resource, database, and fresh-consumer gates all pass. E01: 24/24 fresh-model calls completed with 12/12 exact resume selection in both R6-full and R7-compact arms; compact reduced mean prompt tokens 46.10%. Integrated candidate then passed PostgreSQL 18.6 UTF-8 Alembic 0001->0004, 30/30 tests with zero skips, Ruff, diff check, and history Doctor.
experiments.nextGate: Separate release/cutover review. Do not infer production deployment from candidate verification.

experiments.name: work-standing-consumer-census
experiments.finding: Current Host runtime already does not consume workStanding outside checkpoint_contract. Executable policy tests now enforce that no runtime module reads workStanding, v2 claims round-trip, and ordinary checkpoint patches preserve standing bytes.
experiments.nextGate: Keep v2 envelope compatibility. Revisit physical schema migration only if a later measured simplification benefit exceeds migration cost.

experiments.name: currentness-destroyer
experiments.question: Do stale, missing, future-dated, and conflicting owner observations fail closed to UNKNOWN/REENTRY_REQUIRED without granting authority?

experiments.name: news-separation
experiments.question: Can News be removed from the Host kernel model without breaking the continuity/collaboration/re-entry loop?

experiments.name: feedback-observability
experiments.question: Can every Host change be evaluated against continuity outcome and cost rather than activity count?
